response.reason: The kernel assumes the grid spacing is always 1/8 of the current binade, but e4m3 has subnormals: for |x| < 2^-6 the representable grid is the fixed subnormal spacing 2^-9, so this kernel outputs values (e.g. multiples of 2^-23 near 2^-20) that are not representable in e4m3 at all. It also ignores overflow behavior above the e4m3 maximum, so it does not round to the nearest representable e4m3 value in those regions.
